caption: 💌 Do not forget to save this recipe for Halloween week & share with another mama who needs healthy snack inspo. @bella.healthytinytummies 🎃These Halloween pumpkin bagels are fun , nutritious, and picky-eater friendly. Made with red lentils, pumpkin purée, oats, and yogurt, they sneak in protein, fiber, and veggies, all in one bite. Perfect for toddlers and kids who need energy without the sugar crash. 🍂 🎃 Halloween Bagel 🥯 Recipe  (toddler-approved!) 1 cup red lentils (200g) (soaked 2–3h, drained) 1/3 cup pumpkin purée (100g) 1/8 cup yogurt (40g) 2 tbsp olive oil  1/4 tsp baking soda 1/2 tsp lemon juice 3/4 cup oat flour (90g) 👉 Blend everything until smooth. Shape with wet hands into mini pumpkins 🎃, bake at 200°C (390°F) for ~20 min. Let cool before serving toddlers. 🍁Pitted dates, cut into sticks on the top of bagels  🫶 Why moms love this recipe: Naturally gluten-free No refined sugar High in plant protein Fun festive shape toddlers actually want to eat #toddlerapproved #toddlersnacks #halloween #blwrecipes #bagels
